proposals.reason: An original vector lockup sourced from the bank website is preserved on Commons, and its standalone magenta P emblem matches the currently served official programme header. The operating bank remains legally КБ Ренессанс Кредит (ООО), registration 3354, while its consumer brand is Ренессанс Банк. The accepted white emblem differs: its lower horizontal arm has a diagonal terminal, whereas the supported original has a vertical terminal; its backing is #EA3378 rather than source emblem #FF0078. Propose faithful isolation of the source magenta emblem, not recoloring it white or retaining an unsupported backing.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Correct baseline's unsupported diagonal terminal using the current bank's sourced original standalone magenta emblem. Presentation becomes a transparent magenta mark rather than unsupported white-on-#EA3378 circular adaptation; justify and review that difference separately.
